row.title: FULLSTACK-1: every system deploys repo, back end and a public web UI
row.body: Rowan 2026-11-25 asked that every Ultrastable system deploy its repo, back end and public web UI by itself. tenantrepos --check now fails a registered tenant with no public front end (a live topology Worker with a route, or an https frontend); deploy-ultrastable redeploys tenant code still moving in instances/*/worker. The Replication Ledger gains reader pages in worker/site.js and the topology Worker ultrastable-replication-ledger with route replication-ledger.ultrastable.org; seedlife verifies its /health after the deploy.
